tr-sr-portrait.description: Sagamore Hill, Theodore Roosevelt House. Portrait of Theodore Roosevelt's father
tr-sr-portrait.rights: No known restrictions on publication. For information, see: "Gottscho-Schleisner Collection"  https://hdl.loc.gov/loc.pnp/res.104.gott
tr-sr-portrait.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-sr-portrait.note: Gottscho-Schleisner photograph (1966) of the oil portrait of Theodore Roosevelt Sr. hanging at Sagamore Hill: gilt frame on patterned wallpaper, bookcase below, a mounted specimen along the shelf. It is a photograph of the painting in situ, not the painting itself, and captions must say so. SIZE LIMITATION: 339x420 is all that exists. LOC record 2018733677 offers no larger derivative and the storage-services master TIFF (5a29283u.tif) is the same 339x420; the DAM has nothing for Theodore Roosevelt Sr. Every other hero in the repo is 1400 wide. Until a better scan is found, use this file sparingly - hero plus at most one question - and never at full-bleed width.
